submission_contract.primary_native_pair: Submit exactly one primary native model/result pair from one solver: one ANSYS MAPDL .db plus one .rst, or one Abaqus .cae plus one .odb.
submission_contract.auxiliary_artifacts: Auxiliary solver files may be present but are not used in place of the required primary pair.

visible_goal: Build and solve a plane-stress plate with a central circular hole under uniaxial tension; report maximum longitudinal normal stress Sxx and its gross-nominal stress concentration proxy.
selection_reason: Plane-stress plate-with-hole is a canonical FEA benchmark available in both tools.

metric_contract.max_stress: MPa; maximum longitudinal normal stress Sxx from the native nodally averaged or nodally extrapolated field at the final static result
metric_contract.stress_concentration_proxy: dimensionless; max_stress divided by the 10 MPa gross nominal tensile stress
